title: Beta Diversity Pipeline — Parameter Schema
description: Nextflow pipeline for PCoA/NMDS ordination, PERMANOVA, and beta dispersion of microbiome feature tables.

input_output_options.title: Input / Output Options
input_output_options.description: Parameters for specifying input feature tables, metadata, and output location.

feature_table.description: Path to the input feature table (BIOM, TSV, or GTDB format).
feature_table.help_text: Accepts BIOM files, tab-separated feature tables, or GTDB taxonomy output files.

meta_table.description: Path to sample metadata CSV file. First column must be sample IDs.
meta_table.help_text: A comma-separated file where the first column contains sample identifiers matching the feature table.

taxonomy_table.description: Path to a tab-separated taxonomy table (required for tsv/gtdb input formats).
taxonomy_table.help_text: Two-column TSV: feature ID and semicolon-separated taxonomy string. Handles SILVA (D_0__) and GTDB (d__) prefixes.

tree_file.description: Path to a Newick phylogenetic tree (.nwk). Required for unifrac and wunifrac distances.
tree_file.help_text: If unifrac or wunifrac distance is selected but no tree is provided, the pipeline falls back to bray-Curtis with a warning.

input_format.description: Format of the input feature table.
input_format.help_text: biom: QIIME2/BIOM format. tsv: tab-separated with taxonomy column. gtdb: same as tsv but with GTDB taxonomy prefixes.

output_dir.description: Directory where output CSV files will be published.
output_dir.help_text: Created automatically if it does not exist.

filtering_options.title: Filtering Options
filtering_options.description: Parameters for filtering samples and features before analysis.

min_library_size.description: Minimum total read count per sample. Samples below this threshold are removed.

exclude_column.description: Metadata column used to identify samples for exclusion.
exclude_column.help_text: Used together with --exclude_values. Leave empty to disable.

exclude_values.description: Comma-separated values in exclude_column that mark samples for removal.
exclude_values.help_text: e.g. 'Control,Blank' removes samples where exclude_column matches those values.

grouping_options.title: Grouping Options
grouping_options.description: Parameters defining how samples are assigned to groups and visual subgroups.

groups_column.description: Metadata column to use as the primary grouping variable (Groups).
groups_column.help_text: Mutually exclusive with groups_paste_columns. Required for beta dispersion.

groups_paste_columns.description: Comma-separated metadata columns whose values are pasted together to form the Groups variable.
groups_paste_columns.help_text: e.g. 'Treatment,Timepoint' creates groups like 'Control Day1'. Takes priority over groups_column.

type_column.description: Metadata column for a secondary grouping variable (Type), used for visual shape mapping.
type_column.help_text: Optional. Included in the coordinates CSV when provided.

type2_column.description: Metadata column for a tertiary grouping variable (Type2), used for ellipse grouping.
type2_column.help_text: Optional. Defaults to Groups when not set.

connections_column.description: Metadata column identifying which samples are connected by lines.
connections_column.help_text: Optional. Included in the coordinates CSV for downstream use.

subconnections_column.description: Metadata column for a secondary level of sample connections.
subconnections_column.help_text: Optional. Included in the coordinates CSV for downstream use.

ordination_options.title: Ordination Options
ordination_options.description: Parameters controlling ordination method, distance metric, and taxonomy level.

taxon_rank.description: Taxonomy level at which to collapse the feature table before ordination.

ordination_method.help_text: pcoa: Principal Coordinates Analysis (cmdscale). nmds: Non-metric Multidimensional Scaling (metaMDS). NMDS includes stress value in output.

distance_metric.description: Comma-separated list of beta diversity distance metrics to run in parallel.
distance_metric.help_text: Supported values: bray (Bray-Curtis), jaccard, unifrac (Unweighted UniFrac; tree required), wunifrac (Weighted UniFrac; tree required), aitchison (CLR-transformed Euclidean). Multiple values run as separate parallel processes, e.g. 'bray,jaccard,wunifrac'. Results are written with the metric name embedded in each filename.

ellipse_kind.description: Method used to compute ordination ellipses (passed to vegan::ordiellipse).

label.description: Analysis label appended to all output file names.

permanova_options.title: PERMANOVA Options
permanova_options.description: Parameters for PERMANOVA (adonis2) analysis run alongside ordination.

permanova_variables.description: Comma-separated metadata column names to include in the PERMANOVA model.
permanova_variables.help_text: e.g. 'Treatment,Age' fits dist ~ Treatment + Age. Leave empty to skip PERMANOVA.

permanova_permutations.description: Number of permutations for the PERMANOVA test.

p_adjust_method.description: Method for adjusting PERMANOVA p-values for multiple comparisons.
p_adjust_method.help_text: BH: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR. bonferroni: Bonferroni correction. holm: Holm step-down. none: no adjustment (raw p-values).

dispersion_options.title: Beta Dispersion Options
dispersion_options.description: Parameters specific to the beta dispersion (betadisper) process.
dispersion_options.help_text: Beta dispersion is run for all pairwise group comparisons. Either groups_column or groups_paste_columns is required.

output_options.title: Output Options
output_options.description: Additional output formats produced after all analyses complete.

merge_parquet.description: Merge all output CSVs into a single Parquet file with analysis, table, and distance_metric metadata columns.
merge_parquet.help_text: Writes beta_diversity_{label}.parquet to output_dir. CSVs from all metrics are stacked with NA-fill; filter by 'distance_metric', 'analysis', and 'table' columns downstream.
